confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are the most reliable; hostel and hotel rates swing with season, events and booking lead time, so accommodation is least certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct price knowledge is only moderate. The FX value comes from RBA overview-page text surfaced in search, not a page I opened; a 14 October 2026 RBA value may exist but could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single external comparable city was used. Restaurant levels were reasoned against similar high-cost Asian financial hubs such as Singapore and Tokyo, and budget accommodation against Kowloon's dense guesthouse and hostel stock.

anchor_basis.beer: local lager, one standard serving at a casual restaurant, about HKD 55
anchor_basis.coffee: cappuccino at a chain cafe such as Pacific Coffee, about HKD 45
anchor_basis.inexp_meal_1p: cha chaan teng set meal with a drink, about HKD 70
anchor_basis.midrange_meal_2p: three-course dinner for two at a mid-range restaurant, no drinks, about HKD 850 total
anchor_basis.cocktail: standard cocktail at a mid-priced bar in Central, about HKD 130
anchor_basis.wine_glass: house wine by the glass at a mid-range restaurant, about HKD 100
anchor_basis.hostel_dorm_1p: bed in a 6-8 bed mixed dorm at a registered hostel, about HKD 240 per night
anchor_basis.hostel_private_2p: private double room with shared bath at a registered hostel, about HKD 600 per night
